TC-20/S19.title: Dashboards on phone width (Pixel 7, iPhone 15; Chromium emulation)
TC-20/S19.detail: PW, local stack 25acd727, model mocked or blocked at the socket (tripwire clean). Judged 4/4, 20 record-only. Both dashboards at Pixel 7 (412 px) and iPhone 15 (393 px) size, Chromium device emulation (not WebKit, not the native apps). Judged (a physician must read the right number): no count truncated, 4/4 tiles x 2 settings x 2 profiles. Recorded (our own layout checks): four tiles in one row, no tile label cut (but 'In Progress' wraps to two lines, so its number sits higher than the other three), no sideways scroll, rows 64-80 px tall, no fixed bottom bar on the dashboard. iPhone in real WebKit and the native apps are not covered here.
